capabilities: Add C4 people, systems, containers and components
Create and reverse relationships across levels
Zoom into systems and containers to build nested diagrams
Attach Markdown notes and key-value metadata
extras: Code-level C4 diagrams are not supported; note marks are overlay-only and do not appear in exported images.
intentEvidence: Obsidian plugin that adds C4 model diagrams to Excalidraw drawings
problem: Excalidraw drawings have no built-in structure for building and navigating C4 architecture diagrams level by level.

relations.evidence: Other plugins may draw their own kind of diagram in Excalidraw drawings too, such as Excalidraw Mind Map.

summary: Excalidraw extension for drawing C4 model diagrams with people, systems, containers, components and relationships across zoomable levels.
